t: You're standing where Sayes Court once stood, a manor house and garden in Deptford. Today it lies buried beneath Convoys Wharf and Sayes Court Park, and there's little sign of its former glory. In the seventeenth century the diarist John Evelyn created a celebrated garden here that drew crowds of visitors. His grandson, also John Evelyn, was born here in 1682. He became a politician, sat in the House of Commons, and served as Postmaster-general from 1708 to 1715.
